messages.text: For the lumen orders backfill, which source table do we use? I see both ORD_HDR and ORD_HDR_LGCY.
Use ORD_HDR. ORD_HDR_LGCY is frozen since 2019 and deprecated, so only union it in for pre-2019 history after SME sign-off.
Thanks. And order_total_amount maps to TOT_AMT? Is it net of discounts?
Yes, TOT_AMT is already net of discounts and excludes tax, same as order_total_amount.
Heads up on ITEM_MSTR: ITEM_DESC is actually the short product title shown on the site and receipts. product_name should come from ITEM_DESC, not ITEM_LONG_DESC (that one is PDP marketing copy).
STR_DIM.RGN_CD uses the old six-character region codes. REGION in STORE_LOCATIONS maps from RGN_CD through the REF.RGN_XREF lookup.
The source org never had a reviews feed, so customer_reviews starts fresh and has nothing to backfill.
Reminder: source CHNL_CD values are STORE/WEB/APP and sales_channel expects lowercase store/web/app.
